gloss: a point; some truth; a certain logic

definitions.gloss: a point; some truth; a certain logic
definitions.explanation: A measure of reason or truth in what someone says, even if it is not the whole story. Almost always heard in {一理|いちり}ある, used to concede that an argument has merit.

examples.english: Your opinion has a point too.
I do think there is some truth in what he says.

examples.japanese: ⟦{反対派|はんたいは}→反対派：30532_hantaiha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{一理|いちり}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}う→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧ことにした。
examples.english: The opposing side's argument has a point, so we decided to discuss it once more.

notes:
⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one) + {理|り} (reason, logic): literally "one reason". The word concedes partial merit: the speaker grants a point without fully agreeing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一理|いちり}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a point
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{一理|いちり}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there's something to that too
- {一理|いちり}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧…: there is a point to it, but…
- {百害|ひゃくがい}⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧{一利|いちり}なし: all harm and no benefit (a different {一利|いちり}, "one benefit")

WATCH OUT:
The proverb {百害|ひゃくがい}⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧{一利|いちり}なし is written {一利|いちり} (benefit), not {一理|いちり} (reason); the two sound the same.
